item.title: 「存在しない町」Doveland の記憶があると大勢が主張
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

AI(NotebookML plus) 整理。

要旨​

消えた町、ダブランドの謎

複数の資料は、ウィスコンシン州にあったとされるものの、公式記録が一切ない「ダブランド」という町の謎を探求しています。この現象は、歴史上の失われた集落や、説明もなく人々が消え去ったとされる場所など、世界中の同様の不可解な出来事と対比されます。

ダブランドに関しては、多くの人々がその町を訪れたり住んだりした具体的な記憶を持っている一方、その存在を証明する物理的な証拠が見つからないというパラドックスが強調されています。軍事プロジェクトとの関連や自然災害、さらには次元のずれや集合的虚偽記憶といった様々な仮説が提示されますが、どの説明も決定的な証拠を欠いており、ダブランドの失踪は未解決のままの謎として描かれています。

音声対話​

https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/c0c41f58-2925-4c2a-a784-c2f8eeca3c49/audio

動画(30:22)​

The Vanishing of Doveland

AI 整理​

Me: ソースは Podcast の文字起こしです。この内容を整理して。

AI

(AI の不調。なぜか、chat 欄は何を聞いても、生成中のままいくら待っても完了せず。後日、再度試す予定。音声対話は正常に生成されたのだが。)

要約

ブリーフィング資料：消えた町、ダブランドの謎

  1. 概要

本資料は、「消えた町、ダブランドの謎」と題されたソースに基づいて、記録上存在しないにも関わらず、多くの人々がその存在を記憶しているとされるウィスコンシン州の町、ダブランド（Doveland）にまつわる謎をレビューするものです。ダブランドの事例は、歴史的な消失集落の謎（ロアノーク、ホア・ヴェルデ、アンジャクニ湖）や、目撃者の記憶のみに残る消失した場所の物語と並行して語られます。

  1. 主要なテーマ

    消失集落の謎: 経済的、政治的、または自然的原因による一般的な町の衰退とは異なり、物的証拠や記録がほとんど存在せず、文字通り「消えた」集落に関する考察。 記憶と記録の矛盾: 多くの個人の鮮明な記憶と、公式記録や物理的な証拠の欠如との間の矛盾。これは、特にダブランドの謎の中心的な要素です。 デジタル時代の都市伝説と集団記憶: インターネットを介して広がる情報、共有される記憶、そしてそれがどのように都市伝説や集団的な誤った記憶（マンデラ効果）を形成しうるかについての考察。 政府の秘密活動と隠蔽: ダブランドの存在が、冷戦時代の秘密軍事プロジェクト、特にプロジェクト・サングイン/ELFに関連している可能性についての推測。政府が秘密保持のために町の存在を隠蔽または消去した可能性を探ります。 超常現象/非科学的な説明: 次元間移動、タイムスリップ、または地下深くに存在する未知の存在との遭遇といった、より非現実的な可能性についても言及されています。

  2. 最も重要なアイデア・事実

    ダブランドの特異性: 多くの消失集落には何らかの物理的な痕跡が残されていますが、ダブランドには公式記録、地図上の記載、あるいは物理的な遺跡が一切見つかっていません。 "However, Doveland, Wisconsin does not appear on any map, and no online records of the town can be found." (0:08:04) "In recent years, researchers have noted that the town doesn't appear in any credible source prior to 2015." (0:27:30) 多数の目撃者/記憶保持者: 公式記録がないにも関わらず、インターネット上を中心に、ダブランドを訪問した、あるいはそこで育ったと主張する人々が多数存在します。彼らはダブランドを「眠たい中西部のコミュニティで、親切な隣人、地元の店、そして夏のフェアがある場所」と一様に描写します。 "All across the internet, users began claiming that they had distinct memories of visiting or even growing up in Doveland." (0:08:33) "To hundreds of very real people... it was like any other small community in Wisconsin." (0:09:52) プロジェクト・サングイン/ELFとの関連性の示唆: 複数のインターネットユーザーが、ダブランドが冷戦時代の米海軍の通信プロジェクト、プロジェクト・サングイン（後にプロジェクトELFとして縮小実施）に関連していた可能性を指摘しています。 "The main thing I remember is that it had to do with Project Sanguine in the early 60s." (0:12:00) "If I remember correctly, the town was built as a part of Project Sanguine in the mid to late 60s." (0:16:59) プロジェクト・サングインは、ウィスコンシン州の広範囲に巨大な地下通信網を構築する計画でしたが、計画縮小版のプロジェクトELFはウィスコンシン州クラムレイク近郊で1980年代から2004年まで運用されました。 「何か間違ったことが起こった」という記憶: プロジェクト・サングインとの関連を語るユーザーの一部は、「何か非常に間違ったことが起こった」あるいは「町が洪水に見舞われたか何かだ」といった出来事を記憶しています。 "Maybe everyone left when the project was cancelled, but I thought something went very wrong." (0:17:06) "I remember them flooding the town, or something." (0:17:41) これは、大規模な掘削作業が地滑り、陥没、または洪水を引き起こし、その結果として町が破壊され、政府がそれを隠蔽したというシナリオを支持するものです。 政府による秘密都市の先例: 米国政府が秘密プロジェクト遂行のために一般には存在を知られていない都市を建設した例として、ロスアラモス（ニューメキシコ州）やマーキュリー（ネバダ州）が挙げられています。これは、ダブランドも同様の秘密都市であった可能性を示唆しています。 "They didn't just build projects, they built entire towns." (0:15:09) "The town didn't exist on maps, and mail was addressed simply to P.O. Box 1663, Santa Fe. Nonetheless, researchers and their families lived there for years..." (0:15:31) マンデラ効果の可能性: ダブランドの謎に対する懐疑的な説明として、マンデラ効果、すなわち多くの人が共有する鮮明だが誤った記憶である可能性が提起されています。これは、特にインターネット上で情報が共有されることで記憶が補強されるという心理的なメカニズムによるものかもしれません。 "Some people attribute this to a phenomenon known as the Mandela Effect, where large groups of people share vivid but false memories." (0:25:59) "Essentially, the more a story is told, the more real it feels." (0:26:36) 自然災害説の否定: 地震による巨大なシンクホールなど、自然災害による消失説も提唱されましたが、ウィスコンシン州の地質学的特性や、もし発生していれば残るはずの痕跡を考慮すると、この説は説得力に欠けるとされています。 "Wisconsin isn't known for its seismic activity, and it lies well away from major fault lines." (0:21:37) "Plus, even if a sinkhole had occurred, it would have left a scar, something visible or measurable." (0:21:46)

  3. 未解決の疑問

ダブランドは本当に存在したのか？ もし存在したとすれば、なぜ公式記録が一切ないのか？ なぜ多くの人がその記憶を持っているのか？ プロジェクト・サングイン/ELFとの関連は事実なのか？ そして、「何か間違ったこと」とは具体的に何だったのか？ 政府による意図的な隠蔽があったのか？ それともこれは集団的な誤った記憶、デジタル時代の都市伝説に過ぎないのか？

  1. 結論（暫定的）

ダブランドの謎は、個人の記憶と公式記録の間の深い断絶を示しています。プロジェクト・サングイン/ELFとの関連や政府の秘密都市の可能性といった説明は魅力的ですが、現時点では決定的な証拠はありません。一方で、多数の記憶保持者の存在は無視できず、単なる都市伝説として片付けるには不十分な側面もあります。最も合理的な説明は、秘密の軍事プロジェクトに関連して建設された町が、何らかの事故（特に洪水が示唆されている）によって破壊され、その存在が政府によって徹底的に隠蔽されたという説ですが、これも証明には至っていません。最終的に、ダブランドの謎は、私たちが現実、記憶、そして歴史をどのように理解するかについて問いを投げかけています。

timeline と関係者

ダブランドの謎：タイムライン

1587年: ロアノーク植民地が現在のノースカロライナ州沖合に設立される。 1587年 - 1590年: ロアノーク植民地への複数回の補給船が派遣される。 1590年: ロアノーク植民地に到着した補給船が、集落が消滅しているのを発見。唯一の手がかりは「Croatoan」と刻まれた標識と、同じフレーズの最初の4文字が刻まれた木だった。ロアノーク植民地の住民の行方に関する謎が始まる。 1923年: ブラジルの小規模な町、ホア・ヴェルデが住民が一晩で痕跡なく消えたと報告される。 1930年: カナダ北部のアニャクニ湖畔で、罠猟師が放棄されたイヌイットの村を発見したと主張。焚き火はまだくすぶっており、食事が手付かずだったが、住民が戻る兆候はなかった。近くの墓地が掘り起こされており、住民が亡くなった親族を連れて行った可能性が示唆される。 1943年: ロスアラモスがニューメキシコ州に設立される。これは秘密裏に最初の原子爆弾を開発するためのもので、地図には存在せず、郵便はP.O. Box 1663, Santa Feとだけ記載されていた。 1958年: ジョージア州沖合でB-47爆撃機が別のジェット機と空中衝突し、タイビー島近くにMark 15水爆を投下。この爆弾は回収されず、詳細が公表されたのは数十年後だった。 1960年代初頭: プロジェクト・サングインに関連してダブランドという町が存在した、という記憶を持つ人物がいる。 1960年代半ば - 後半: プロジェクト・サングインの一部としてダブランドが建設されたという記憶を持つ人物がいる。この町は主に軍関係者とその家族が居住していたとされる。 1980年代: プロジェクトELF（プロジェクト・サングインの縮小版）が完全に稼働開始。ウィスコンシン州クラム湖近郊に位置し、地下ケーブルとアンテナを使用して潜水艦と通信していた。 1990年代: ダブランドという町が消滅した、という記憶を持つ人々がいる。 2004年: プロジェクトELFが運用を終了する。 2015年以前: クレジットできる情報源にダブランドという町が登場した記録がない。 2010年代後半: インターネット上で「ダブランド、ウィスコンシン」という検索語句が多くのユーザーにサジェストされるようになる。これは、存在しない町の検索が多発しているという奇妙な状況を引き起こす。 不明（過去20年間）: インターネット上の様々な場所（Redditフォーラム、超常現象関連掲示板など）で、ダブランドを訪れたり、そこで育ったりしたという人々の証言が現れ始める。彼らは町を小さな眠ったコミュニティとして描写するが、具体的な地名や場所については記憶が曖昧である。ダブランドの名前と紋章が入った古いTシャツやコーヒーマグカップの写真が投稿される。 不明（過去数年間）: インターネット掲示板で、ダブランドがプロジェクト・サングインに関連しており、何らかの「事件」や「問題」が発生した後に町が消滅したという投稿が現れる。特に、掘削に関連した浸水や地滑りの可能性が示唆される。これらの投稿はオンライン調査員たちの注目を集める。 不明: ダブランドの存在を疑問視するインターネットユーザーが現れる。ウィスコンシン州に長年住んでいるが、ダブランドという町を聞いたことがないと主張する。 現在: ダブランドの存在に関する謎は解決されておらず、公式記録に町の痕跡が見当たらないにも関わらず、多くの人々が町の記憶を持っているという状況が続いている。様々な説明（自然災害、政府による隠蔽、異次元現象、マンデラ効果など）が議論されている。

ダブランドの謎：登場人物

ここにリストアップされるのは、提供された情報源で言及されている「人物」または「人物群」です。多くの場合は特定の個人ではなく、集団や証言者として言及されています。

ロアノーク植民地のイングランド人入植者たち: 1587年に現在のノースカロライナ州沖合に集落を設立した100人以上の人々。1590年に痕跡なく消滅したとされる。 クロアトアン族: ロアノーク植民地に近い同名の島に住んでいた先住民の部族。ロアノーク植民地消滅の謎における手がかりとしてその名が残されている。 ホア・ヴェルデの住民たち: 1923年に一夜にして町から消えたと報告されているブラジルの町の住民たち。 カナダの罠猟師: 1930年にアニャクニ湖畔で放棄されたイヌイットの村を発見したと主張した人物。 イヌイットの村の住民たち（アニャクニ湖）: 1930年に放棄された状態で発見されたカナダ北部の村の住民たち。 ロバート・オッペンハイマー: 1943年に設立されたロスアラモスで最初の原子爆弾を開発した科学者チームのリーダー。 ロスアラモスの研究者とその家族たち: 1943年以降、地図に載らない秘密の町ロスアラモスに住んでいた人々。 マーキュリー（ネバダ州）の住民たち: 核爆弾実験のサポートサイトとして設立された町の住民たち。一般公開されていなかった。 ダブランドに住んでいた（または訪れた）と主張する人々: インターネット上でダブランドに関する記憶を共有している多数の人々。彼らは町を小さなフレンドリーなコミュニティとして描写するが、具体的な詳細については記憶が曖昧なことが多い。多くは60代または70代であると示唆されている。 軍関連の背景を持つインターネットユーザー（ダブランドに関する投稿者）: ダブランドが軍関係者の家族が多く住む町であり、プロジェクト・サングインに関連していたと主張する少なくとも2人のインターネットユーザー。彼らは町で何らかの「事件」や「問題」が発生したという印象を持っている。 ウィスコンシン州に長年住んでいるインターネットユーザー（ダブランド懐疑派）: ウィスコンシン州に30年以上住み、軍隊経験もあるが、ダブランドという町を聞いたことがないと主張し、町の存在に懐疑的なインターネットユーザー。 プロジェクト・サングイン/ELFに関与した軍関係者、エンジニアなど: アメリカ海軍および政府関係者で、冷戦時代に極低周波通信ネットワークを構築しようとしたプロジェクトに関わった人々。機密保持契約に縛られていた可能性が示唆されている。 フィル・シュナイダー: 地下深部の軍事基地（DUMs）や、人類と地球外生命体との間で秘密裏に戦争が行われているという理論について広範に語ったとされる人物（故人）。ダブランドの謎の超常現象的な説明に関連して言及されている。

文字起こし

広告はカット済み

Plenty of towns have disappeared over the years. In most cases the explanations range from economic problems to government initiatives to resources drying up. But what about the towns that truly and quite literally vanished without a trace? It's not as rare a phenomenon as some people might think, and for thousands of people in the US state of Wisconsin, it's a perplexing reality. Given the presence of so many vivid memories, how can we possibly explain the vanishing of Dublin? As long as there have been maps, there have been whispered accounts of entire towns, villages and settlements disappearing without explanation. (0:01:33)

Sometimes a name survives, a dot on the map that seems to correspond with nothing. In other cases, these once fruitful communities exist only in the memories of a select few people. This strange phenomenon can be found across cultures, across centuries, and now across the internet. At the heart of each of these tales lies a chilling question. How do you prove that something once existed, when every bit of proof is gone? (0:02:04)

The most famous example of a disappearing town is probably the Lost Colony of Roanoke. In 1587, over 100 English settlers established a settlement on a small patch of land off the coast of present-day North Carolina. Surviving records and ship manifests indicate that multiple resupply missions were sent there. The colony had a large wooden fort and numerous homes, and by all accounts, things seemed to be going quite well. (0:02:37)

But three years later, another resupply ship arrived to find everything gone. The fort had been dismantled, and the few homes that remained were now overgrown with weeds. The only clue was a signpost with the word Croatoan carved into it, and a tree bearing the first four letters of the same phrase, C-R-O-A. Though people have agonized over the potential meaning of this word for centuries, it was perfectly clear at the time. (0:03:10)

The Croatoan were a native tribe who lived on a neighbouring island of the same name. But what was the meaning of the carvings? Had the relationship between the two villages soured, resulting in a deadly attack? Had the settlers encountered some sort of trouble and gone to live with the natives? To this day, no definitive answer has been found. (0:03:34)

There were no bodies, no signs of conflict, and many valuable provisions left behind. This has led some historians to believe a plague may have struck the island. But if that's the case, where are the dead? And why would nobody think to write a letter detailing the event? As puzzling as the mystery of the lost colony is, it is only the tip of the disappearing village iceberg. (0:04:00)

There's also the puzzling tale of Hoa Verde, a small Brazilian town that reportedly emptied overnight in 1923 with no trace as to where the residents might have gone. Or the strange story surrounding Lake Anjacuni in northern Canada. In 1930, a trapper claimed to have stumbled upon a deserted Inuit village, where he reported that campfires were still smouldering and that meals had been left untouched. (0:04:23)

Yet it was abundantly clear that the residents were not coming back. (0:04:28)

Wherever they went, they had dug up a nearby graveyard so that they could take their long-dead relatives with them.

Unsettling as these cases may be, there remains some physical evidence of the abandoned community. In other stories, towns and villages physically cease to be where they once stood. Paranormal culture is rife with tales of travelers who visit unfamiliar, often rural towns. Upon leaving, they suddenly find that the road doesn't lead back to where they'd been. (0:06:21)

Confused, they stop at the nearest petrol station or hotel to ask about the discrepancy, where they are calmly informed that there is no such place. In all of these cases, people will report talking to others, eating meals, interacting with staff, sometimes even spending the night, only to return later and find nothing there. It has all the makings of a science fiction movie, until one realizes that complete strangers often report having the exact same experience. (0:06:55)

In some cases, the occurrences are years or even decades apart. And then, there is Doveland. First whispered about in obscure corners of the internet, the story of Doveland, Wisconsin began gaining traction in the late 2010s. It started, some say, with a Google search. Users reported typing Doveland into the search bar, only for it to automatically suggest Doveland, Wisconsin. That in itself wouldn't be strange, as Google often prioritizes searches based on popularity. (0:07:34)

The only problem was that there is no Doveland, Wisconsin. Depending on the rarity of the phrase, it can take hundreds of thousands of searches to prompt Google's algorithm to autocorrect a search term. So, why would so many people be searching for a town that doesn't exist? Technology experts will often point out that Google also factors website mentions and official data when determining keywords. (0:08:04)

However, Doveland, Wisconsin does not appear on any map, and no online records of the town can be found. (0:08:12)

Until the very conspiracy we are discussing started, there doesn't appear to be any reason for anyone to be looking for it at all. But, it turns out, there was indeed a reason. All across the internet, users began claiming that they had distinct memories of visiting or even growing up in Doveland. The majority of these people described the small town in exactly the same way. (0:08:41)

A sleepy midwestern community home to friendly neighbours, local shops and summer fairs. Some people even posted photos of old t-shirts and coffee mugs, emblazoned with the town's name and crest. Yet, when pressed for details like street names, landmarks and the actual location, the users would find themselves unable to remember anything. Meanwhile, internet sleuths were unable to find any corroborating evidence. To sceptics, it was an open and shut case. (0:09:14)

An internet-born urban legend fuelled by digital folklore and nostalgia. But to believers, these people are focusing on the wrong part of the story. Because the truly unsettling thing about Doveland isn't that no one can find it. It's that so many people remember it. The story goes like this. In the heart of America's dairyland, somewhere between the thick forests and rolling countryside, there was once a town called Doveland. To hundreds of very real people, many of whom have posted comments and photos on the internet over the past two decades, it was like any other small community in Wisconsin. They describe it as the kind of place where everyone knew each other's names, where neighbours wave from their porches, and children chase fireflies until the late hours of the night. (0:10:10)

Then, sometime in the 1990s, it vanished. And nobody knows why. It only takes a few minutes to confirm the fact that there are zero official records of a Doveland in the Wisconsin state archives. Even state employees haven't been able to conjure up any deeds, tax rolls, death certificates or birth announcements related to the supposed town. There are likewise no property maps or zoning changes, no mentions in the newspapers, not a single piece of verifiable evidence. (0:10:46)

But whilst there may have been a shortage of information about Doveland, there was no shortage of people looking for it. Across various corners of the internet, from Reddit forums to paranormal message boards, people continued to trade stories of visiting or growing up in this sleepy Wisconsin town. Many expressed frustration that something they considered to be such a formative part of their lives had somehow gotten lost. (0:11:21)

Most of the former Dovelanders were now in their 60s or even 70s, and they reasoned that the omission must have been due to some sort of colossal filing error. The town had been small after all. Perhaps it had been absorbed by some suburb, and the records had simply been lost. Then, things got a little bit more sinister. Someone posted the following on a message board about the topic. (0:11:45)

I just learned of all the noise surrounding Doveland, and I think I can add some insight. (0:11:52)

Doveland was a small town in Wisconsin that housed a lot of military families. My father lived there for a year or two, and spoke of it occasionally. The main thing I remember is that it had to do with Project Sanguine in the early 60s. I don't think it was X-Files type stuff, but the town was destroyed after an incident. (0:12:14)

I thought they were digging up a ton of land for something, and they flooded the town, or something. But this is a rehashed, second-hand memory from years ago. Amidst hundreds of similar posts, this one caught online investigators' attention, and the reasons were obvious. The user not only mentioned the military and a potential incident, but they actually identified a specific operation, Project Sanguine. It doesn't take long to confirm that this was indeed a legitimate military endeavour. (0:12:48)

Proposed by the US Navy during the Cold War, Project Sanguine aimed to create a vast underground communications network that could use ELF radio waves, an acronym for Extremely Low Frequency, to communicate with nuclear submarines. The original plan was ambitious to the point of being frightening. It involved laying more than 6,000 miles of buried cable across nearly two-fifths of Wisconsin. Estimates state the final system would have required more than 100 underground power plants and consumed over 800 megawatts of power. (0:13:30)

It sounds like a massive undertaking, and it would have been. However, the full version was never built. Instead, the government constructed a scaled-down equivalent, which it named Project ELF. Its location? The forests near Clam Lake, Wisconsin. These facts seem to lend instant credence to the Dublin Conspiracy. The only problem was that Project ELF and Project Sanguine were hardly secrets. Indeed, Project ELF worked. (0:14:04)

It was fully operational from the 1980s up until 2004, using massive ground-dipole antennas to send signals through bedrock to submarines thousands of miles away. The same can be said for Project Sanguine. It even has its own Wikipedia page, complete with photos. Despite feeling encouraged by these revelations, believers in the conspiracy still had to face the fact that there was nothing to connect the town to the project. (0:14:34)

And now that they knew the Cold War-era US government might be involved, Wisconsinites began to develop theories as to why. During the 1960s, the Cold War was in full swing. Both the US and Soviet governments were spending billions of dollars a year developing new ways to attack, defend against and spy on one another, and due to a pervasive fear of communist infiltration, secrecy was paramount. (0:15:00)

Eventually, they decided that the best way to keep things away from prying eyes was to hide in plain sight. They didn't just build projects, they built entire towns. The first and most notable example of this was Los Alamos in New Mexico. It was established in 1943 so that Robert Oppenheimer and his team of scientists could develop the first atomic bomb. (0:15:31)

The town didn't exist on maps, and mail was addressed simply to P.O. Box 1663, Santa Fe. Nonetheless, researchers and their families lived there for years, so no doubt dozens, perhaps even hundreds of children remember growing up there. (0:15:44)

The only real difference between the theoretical Doveland and the very real Los Alamos is that the latter is still around today. This is far from the only example. Mercury, Nevada was established as a support site for nuclear bomb testing. At its height, it had thousands of residents, complete with a hospital, church and bowling alley. However, it was completely off-limits to the general public. (0:16:11)

If the United States government was trying to install a massive underground project in Wisconsin, it's not inconceivable that it might take the same approach. Still, if Doveland existed, where is it? Perhaps it has something to do with the incident the user mentioned in their post. In fact, it seems like more than one person remembers something unfortunate happening in the town. Doveland was very real. (0:16:46)

My father used to mention it occasionally before he passed, and the only reason I remember it is because I found it ironic that a town named Doveland was populated by almost exclusively military personnel and their families. If I remember correctly, the town was built as a part of Project Sanguine in the mid to late 60s. Maybe everyone left when the project was cancelled, but I thought something went very wrong. (0:17:08)

You can only dig up that much turf for so long before you're bound to have problems. This means that at least two posters claim that Doveland had a connection to Project Sanguine and have an impression that something terrible happened there. If there was a massive digging project at the time, it's not impossible that something could have gone very, very wrong. Digging too rapidly or too recklessly has been associated with things like landslides and ground collapses, as well as flooding. (0:17:41)

Coincidentally, the first commenter's memories back this up, as he clearly says he remembers them flooding the town or something. Any of these events would not only explain why the town no longer exists, but, assuming people were killed or injured, why the government might want to erase Doveland from the record books. Again, there is precedent for this. In 1958, a B-47 bomber suffered a mid-air collision with another jet off the Georgia coast. (0:18:14)

As a result, it dropped a Mark 15 hydrogen bomb near Tybee Island. Not only was the bomb never recovered, but the public wasn't informed of the details of the incident for decades. There have also been several deaths attributed to testing for so-called Black Projects, such as the U-2 and SR-71 spy planes. Most of these occurred at the highly secretive Area 51, but when families had to be notified, the deaths were attributed to routine training accidents. (0:18:48)

Even freedom of information requests would not suffice, as engineers and military personnel signed lifetime secrecy oaths that extended to their families. If the government made a mistake and ended up burying, burning or flooding a town full of military personnel and their families, they would have no incentive to tell anyone. They would also have the means and the motive to cover it up, especially if nature had already reclaimed the area and hidden much of the evidence. (0:19:18)

But not everyone is convinced. (0:19:22)

One internet user posted the following in response to the two Doveland truthers. As someone who has lived in various places in Wisconsin for over 30 years, and has been in the army, never once has any single person ever mentioned Doveland. Of course, this is only one person's experience, and they do not speak for everyone. After all, Wisconsin is bigger than England, and there are towns in England that the Bedtime Stories team has never heard of either, despite living here all our lives. (0:19:57)

So, is the disappearance of Doveland just a case of digital age folklore? The physical evidence is spotty. A grainy photo from a diner, a newspaper clipping boasting a Doveland agency selling real estate, and some personal photos that may or may not be doctored. But with so many Midwesterners matter-of-factly stating that they either visited or lived there, the Doveland mystery is just too big to ignore. (0:20:27)

What can we say when presented with a town that countless people seem to remember, yet nobody can prove existed? That paradox has given rise to dozens of explanations, each trying to make sense of how an entire community could vanish, not just physically, but from official records as well. One of the earliest ideas floated was that Doveland had fallen victim to a natural disaster of some kind. (0:21:03)

Proponents of this theory believe that perhaps an earthquake opened a massive sinkhole beneath the town, swallowing it in a matter of seconds and erasing all traces of its existence. At first, this might seem like a logical, if dramatic, interpretation, but it quickly falls apart under scrutiny. Wisconsin isn't known for its seismic activity, and it lies well away from major fault lines. Though tremors have affected the region, none have ever come close to the level of destruction this theory requires. (0:21:37)

Plus, even if a sinkhole had occurred, it would have left a scar, something visible or measurable. The same applies to any natural disaster, because there would still be some form of record that the town existed. If anything, its loss would be viewed as a historic tragedy. To accept that Doveland existed, you have to believe that it was never a typical town. This is what the two online commenters assert. (0:22:05)

They remember it as a military town constructed around a specific, potentially secretive project, not unlike Los Alamos. Their memory that something went wrong or that an incident occurred would most likely refer to the military making some sort of mistake. As previously stated, Project ELF reportedly required immense movement of rock and earth. Is it possible the military uncovered an underground lake or caused a rock slide that buried the town? (0:22:32)

If so, that would explain why it no longer exists, and thanks to freedom of information requests, we know that the Cold War era US government was not keen to admit mistakes, even if they resulted in military or civilian deaths. The flood theory seems the most likely. Wisconsin is home to more than 15,000 lakes, many of which do not occur naturally. (0:22:58)

Is Doveland sitting beneath a small body of water that Wisconsinites now write off as just another reservoir or flooded quarry? Because it seems to fit all the facts, this theory feels highly plausible. However, it's worth noting that even the most restricted military zones tend to leave evidence. Think of the abandoned radar stations scattered across the Midwest, or the silent missile silos still rusting in fields. (0:23:31)

Places like Fort Tilden or the Titan Complexes may be forgotten, but they're not invisible. If Doveland had been part of a military operation, some hunter or hiker should have stumbled across a partially covered road or keep out sign in the woods somewhere. And so, explanations inexorably drift into stranger territory. Perhaps one of the most interesting theories surrounds the possibility that the military may have disturbed something when digging the deep shafts necessary to accommodate Project ELF. Thanks to alleged whistleblowers such as the late Phil Schneider, it has long been suggested that there are in fact thousands of miles of tunnels running beneath the United States. And not all of them are man-made. While some deep underground military bases, or DUMs, are more famous than others, such as the Cheyenne Mountain Complex or Raven Rock in Pennsylvania, many of them are highly secretive, entirely unknown to the general public. (0:24:32)

In fact, there are theories to suggest that many of these bases are controlled and operated by extraterrestrial beings. Schneider spoke extensively about a secretive underground war being waged between human beings and other intelligences. Could the digging involved in Project ELF have stumbled across one of these sites and unleashed something onto the Dublin population? As far-fetched as it may seem, this would perfectly explain why the US government might want to erase all record of the town. (0:25:09)

Elsewhere, some have proposed that Dublin still exists, just not in the way we understand. The town, they say, may have shifted out of sync with our reality. These are often referred to as inter-dimensional rifts or time slips. They describe a fold in space where two dimensions cross, and that according to some, can swallow up people, vehicles, and buildings. So why not an entire town? (0:25:35)

These phenomena are often used to explain many stories where people have vivid memories of visiting a place that later simply ceases to exist. Of course, such theories are hard to prove or dismiss, even when they seem to fit the facts so neatly. Some people attribute this to a phenomenon known as the Mandela Effect, where large groups of people share vivid but false memories. (0:26:02)

Named after the belief that Nelson Mandela died in prison in the 1980s, despite living up until 2013, it is often described as either a convergence of two different timelines, or a kind of psychological trick. If the latter, it's noteworthy that the Mandela Effect can be reinforced by repetition, suggestion, and social feedback. Essentially, the more a story is told, the more real it feels. (0:26:36)

So people who grew up in rural Wisconsin in the 1960s and 70s might have legitimate images of growing up in a small town. Only after being exposed to the Dublin mystery do they begin to ascribe those memories to that specific place. (0:26:46)

For many people, this might be the strangest explanation of all. The reason is that it shows the malleability of the human mind, in a way that leaves many people wondering if any of their memories are truly what they seem. For the more rational-minded, the most likely explanation is the simplest. There never was a Dublin. In recent years, researchers have noted that the town doesn't appear in any credible source prior to 2015. That's a whole 20 years in which nobody seemed to be searching the internet for anything related to the subject. (0:27:30)

It was only when it finally showed up on Reddit threads and paranormal discussion boards that other people began to jump on the, I remember, bandwagon. The world is filled with forgotten places, but Dublin, Wisconsin stands apart. Unlike other vanished towns, it leaves no ruins, no records, no agreed-upon history. Yet people remember it, and many even say they lived there. Was Dublin destroyed, abandoned, erased, or was it never there at all? (0:28:01)

Whatever the truth, the mystery of this small town refuses to disappear. It's difficult to argue that Dublin's absence feels almost deliberate. In the past, there have always been popular mysteries around disappearing communities, but most people seem wholly unwilling to entertain the idea that there was once an idyllic small town in rural Wisconsin that, for some reason, is now just an obscure and fading memory. (0:28:32)

(2025-05-21)

item.title: 仮説 : UFO 内部の ET/人間 が入った透明シリンダー、胎児の培養タンク の起源
item.content:encoded:
仮説​

…は下のような 1950年代前後の SF 物語のイラスト絵や TV の SF 番組の影響。

下にカバー挿絵を示す。他にも、古い TVの SF番組に、

  • 宇宙船の中に人間が入った透明シリンダーが並ぶシーン

を見かけたことがある。こういった昔の SF 作品に由来する心象がタイトルのような「想起」(*1)の起源となっている筈。

(*1)​

abductee が UFO 内部で目撃した培養器のスケッチが下。

ref: Karla Turner, "Taken", p.70

根拠​

下のイラストに UFO は登場しないが、ソース・サイトを見ると、このイラストも UFO/ET/他の惑星 が主題となっていることがわかる。

「UFO 内部での ET による身体検査の起源」は下のような 1950年代前後の SF 物語のイラスト絵や TV の SF 番組の影響。

過去記事、

abductee の implant の起源（ネタ元）はコレだろう

で implant の起源も昔の SF TV 番組である可能性を指摘したが、implant と身体検査は、被害者が台の上に横になって医学的処置を受けるという文脈では地続きになっている。

根拠​

下のイラストに ET も UFO も登場しないが、ソース・サイトを見ると、このイラストも UFO/ET/他の惑星 が主題となっていることがわかる。

右の医師の右手に注目。未来技術の反映として謎の医療器具を人差し指に装着している。だが、気道確保がなってないし、メスの持ち方もまるでダメw

item.title: abductee の implant の起源（ネタ元）はコレだろう（書式変換）
item.content:encoded:
履歴

履歴​

(2025-05-21) 書式変換。

(2024-05-22) 作成。❏ abductee の implant の起源（ネタ元）はコレだろう

前置き​

1973-12-08 に放映された SF TV ドラマのシーン（下）に注目。

切り出し静止画​

目の横の黒い突起が implantで、それを指さして "We are the implants people." と語っている。

implant 処置を受ける男。

コメント​

たまたま、本日の別記事の件で ChatGPT-4o が列挙した番組名を Youtube で検索し、幾つか飛ばし見した中のシーンがこれ。ゆえにこの TV ドラマが本当の最初だとは思えない。このシーンのネタ元となる他の SF ドラマのシーンなり、 SF 小説があった筈。

ただ、この TV 作品でさえ既に半世紀前。ネタ元の作品の事など、たぶん UFO 研究者/マニア/ファン の誰も思い至らないようだ。実際、彼らが implant に関連して過去の SF 作品に言及した事例は私の記憶にはない。

The Starlost Episode 12: “The Implant People“

item.title: Craig Hamilton-Pkerker の予言(2025-05-14) : インドの未来
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

AI(NotebookLM plus) に整理を丸投げ。DeepL は通さない（ので和訳時の抜けや誤訳が回避されている筈）。

該当範囲​

1:48--47:00。ゲストの発言はカット

音声対話 (by AI)​

https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/e031d7a8-16e5-429f-83cc-5cd24011c592/audio

動画(52:35)​

2025 Psychic and Naadi Predictions for India - India’s Rise and China’s Fall

140k views 2025-05-14

要旨​

AI(NotebookLM plus)

テキストは、霊媒であるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏が、インドの未来について語る内容を概説しています。彼は過去の予測が的中したことに触れつつ、インドが経済的にも政治的にも中国を凌駕し、世界的強国となると予測しています。

さらに、ロシアや中国を含む新たな軍事同盟がインドに脅威を与えること、そして環境問題や経済崩壊を経験した近隣諸国（バングラデシュやミャンマー）がインドに併合される可能性についても言及しています。

また、カシミール地方の将来的な完全なインド領化や、パキスタンの衰退、そしてヒマラヤでの大地震によって古代のサラスワティ川が再び現れるという予言にも触れ、これらの出来事がインドの精神的な再生と結びついていることを示唆しています。

AI 対話​

Me:

ソースは UK の予言者の発言です。ソースにある主な予言を整理して。

AI

提供されたソースは、イギリスの予言者であるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏によるインドの未来に関する予言からの抜粋です。パーカー氏は自身をサイキックミディアムと称し、長年にわたりインドに関する予言を行ってきたと述べています。以下に、ソースに記されている彼の主な予言をまとめます。

  • インドの名称変更と経済的台頭:

    • 2021年に、インドが旧名の**バラート(Bharat)**に改名すると予言し、これは数年後にモディ首相によって実行されたと述べています。
    • インドが中国を追い抜くと予言しており、これは2021年から複数回述べていることです。
    • インドは「眠れる巨人」のようなものであり、世界舞台に爆発的に登場すると述べています。
    • 中国への関税引き下げや、より安価な製品、医薬品、電気機器などの製造拠点の必要性から、この予言（インドが中国を経済的に追い抜くこと）が近年中に起こる可能性が非常に高くなったと考えています。
    • インドは中国を経済的・政治的に追い越していくにつれて、中国との軍事衝突が起こると予言しています。
    • インドはますます強くなると見ており、国境を拡大すると数回述べています。これは今後数十年にわたり、インド経済の成長と共に起こると考えています。この拡大は、一部は紛争を通じて、一部は他の国々がこの急成長するインド大陸と統合・合流したいと望むことによって起こると見ています。

  • 国際関係と同盟:

    • 2020年代初頭には考えにくいと思われた、ロシアと中国が同盟を形成することを予言しました。これは軍事同盟として徐々に形成されると述べ、現在（2025年5月13日時点）それが実現している様子（ロシアのメーデーパレードに中国軍が参加）を見ています。
    • この同盟に北朝鮮とイランも加わると予言しており、これも現在（2025年）始まりつつあると考えています。
    • このロシア、中国、イラン、北朝鮮による奇妙な同盟が、インドに脅威をもたらすと予言しています。特にアッサムの茶栽培地域に脅威がある可能性があると感じています。
    • インドはロシアから多くの兵器を購入してきましたが、この同盟の変化により、インドはロシアから距離を置くようになると感じています。
    • ドナルド・トランプ氏がインドで主要な金融取引に関する交渉を行っており、またカシミール問題にも介入したことに言及し、これが彼の予言が現実となる可能性を示唆していると述べています。将来的にインドと（トランプ氏のいる）アメリカは重要な同盟になると感じています。

  • 周辺地域への影響とインドの拡大:

    • ネパールに問題が起こると見ており、強いマオイスト集団が存在するこの地域に中国が影響力を広げると感じています。これはすぐではなく、おそらく数十年先のことと見ています。
    • インドの国境拡大に関わる国として、特にバングラデシュを挙げています。バングラデシュでは大規模な環境問題（モンスーンや洪水）と経済崩壊が起こり、その結果、バングラデシュが自発的にインドの一部になりたいと望むようになると感じています。これは彼が予言した時点では誰も同意しないようなことだったと述べています。
    • ミャンマーも同様の問題に見舞われると見ています。すでに内戦に悩まされていますが、これがさらに悪化し、国が崩壊状態になると感じています。最終的に、新興の民主政府からの要請を受けて、インドがミャンマーに介入すると考えています。これはかなり先の予言です。
    • インドは東方、カンボジアにまで影響を広げると感じています。カンボジア、そして程度の差はあれベトナムは、インド経済の恩恵を受け、インドの「衛星経済国家」となると見ています。これらの国々はインドの一部にはならないものの、将来的に貿易関係が非常に強くなり、インドの新しい製造製品の拠点となると考えています。
    • カシミール問題は現在（トランプ氏の介入などで）落ち着いているものの、今後数年で再び紛争が勃発すると感じています。数年の間にカシミールにインドの軍隊が大規模に増強され、カシミールはますますインド化し、最終的には完全にインド領になると見ています。
    • さらに将来、インドはアフガニスタンにまで影響力や領土を広げると考えています。アフガニスタンのある地域は、特に鉱物資源などの採掘権を巡ってインドによって支配されると見ています。これは非常に遠い将来の予言です。
    • パキスタンは近い将来、崩壊し始めると感じています。特にイラン（王政復古を予言）が崩壊すれば、パキスタンもそれに続いて崩壊に向かうと見ています。
    • パキスタンは、バングラデシュと同様に、深刻な経済問題と環境問題（干ばつ、洪水、火災）に見舞われると感じています。
    • 同時に、パキスタンは影響力と核戦力を失うと見ています。経済的に核兵器を維持できなくなると考えており、これはインドとの核戦争のリスクが減るため、世界にとって良いことだと述べています。
    • 時間はかかるものの、パンジャブ（パキスタン側の一部）がインドに返還されると感じています。パキスタンの一部が最終的にインド領になると見ています。

  • 自然現象とスピリチュアルな出来事:

    • ヒマラヤ地域（チベット、中国、ネパール）で、長い間経験したことのないような非常に大規模な地震が起こると感じています。
    • この地震によってダムが決壊するなどして大量の水が放出され、古代のサラスワティ川の流路に沿って一時的に水が流れると見ています。
    • これは、サラスワティ川が再び流れるとき、インドがカルマ的な問題を克服し、再び偉大さを取り戻すという古代の予言と関連していると述べています。
    • サラスワティ川の流れと共に、偉大な教師たち、特に偉大なアバターが登場するという古代の予言があります。パーカー氏は、これは一人の人物ではなく、すでに地球上に存在する複数の偉大な存在だと感じています。ナーディ・オラクルもこの川の再流について言及していると述べています。

  • 意識と技術の進歩:

    • インドは、特にAIと意識の分野で大きく前進する場所になると見ています。経済的な枠組みにとらわれず、人間の精神という観点から考えているためだと述べています。
    • AIが、インドの神聖幾何学や曼荼羅、ヤントラに見られるような数学と非常に似た結論に達し始めていることに言及し、これが高まる意識と関連しており、インドにおける技術的飛躍を伴う可能性があると考えています。
    • インドからスピリチュアリティの爆発が起こると強く感じています。西洋は、東洋（インド）に秘められた精神的な神聖さを認識するようになると見ています。この古代の知識はインドから来ていると考えています。

  • 政治:

    • モディ首相は可能な限り長く首相を務め続けると感じており、3期目の可能性は非常に高いと見ています。彼はインドでスピリチュアルな存在になりつつあるため、さらに長く続く可能性もあると考えています。

パーカー氏は、これらの予言の多くが自身の予言した時点では起こりそうもないと思われていたことにも言及しています。特に、多くのインド人にとって既知の古代の予言であるサラスワティ川の再流については、当初その予言を知らずに自身のビジョンで見たことに驚きを感じています。彼は、現在が時代の転換点であり、ドゥヴァパラ・ユガ（電気の時代、AIの時代）に入っていると考えており、人類史において特別な時期を迎えていると述べています。

Me:

中国に関する予言をより詳しく述べて。

AI

ソースにあるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏による中国に関する主な予言は以下の通りです。

  • ロシアとの同盟形成

    • 2020年代初頭には考えにくかったことですが、彼はロシアと中国が同盟を形成すると予言しました。
    • この同盟は、徐々に軍事同盟として形成されると述べています。
    • 現在（2025年5月13日時点）は、中国軍がロシアのメーデーパレードに参加していることなどから、これが実現していると考えています。
    • さらに、この同盟には北朝鮮とイランも加わると予言しており、これも現在始まりつつあると感じています。
    • このロシア、中国、イラン、北朝鮮による奇妙な同盟が、インドに脅威をもたらすと予言しています。

  • インドとの関係（経済的追い越しと軍事衝突）

    • インドが中国を追い抜く、特に経済的に追い抜くと、彼は2021年から複数回述べています。
    • 近年、中国への関税引き下げや、より安価な製品製造拠点の必要性から、インドが中国を経済的に追い抜く可能性が非常に高くなったと考えています。
    • インドが中国を経済的・政治的に追い越していくにつれて、中国との軍事衝突が起こると予言しています。
    • 彼は、中国が衰退するにつれてインドが台頭すると見ています。

  • ネパールへの影響力拡大

    • ネパールで今後問題が起こると見ており、特にこの地域に強いマオイスト集団が存在するため、中国が将来的にネパールに影響力（「爪」）を広げると感じています。これはすぐではなく、おそらく数十年先のことと見ています。

  • 大規模地震の発生地域

    • ヒマラヤ地域で、長年経験したことのないような非常に大規模な地震が起こると予言しています。この地震は、チベット、中国、ネパールを含む地域で起こると述べています。

ソースには、上記の点以外に中国に関する具体的な予言は記載されていません。

Me:

AI に 関する/言及している 予言をより詳しく述べて。

AI

提供されたソースには、クレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏によるAI（人工知能）に関するいくつかの予言や見解が含まれています。以下にその詳細をまとめます。

  • パーカー氏は、特にAIと意識の分野において、インドが大きく前進する場所となると見ています。
  • 彼は、AIがインドの神聖幾何学、マンダラ、ヤントラなどに見られる数学と非常に似た種類の結論に到達し始めていることに言及しています。これは、AIにそれらの情報が与えられていないにもかかわらず独立して起こっていることだと述べています。
  • CERNのAIは、量子物理学などの多くの情報を取り込んだ結果、「これはインドの考え方と同じだ」と述べており、まるでグル（導師）のように話しているとさえ言われています。
  • この高まる意識（rising consciousness）とAIの進歩は関連しており、インドにおける技術的な飛躍を伴う可能性があると考えています。
  • パーカー氏は、インドがAIと「意識（consciousness）」の分野で他よりも本当に大きく前進する場所になると強く感じています。
  • その理由として、インドの人々が「経済的な枠組みの外で考え」、「人間の精神（human spirit）」という観点から考えているためだと述べています。
  • 彼は、インドのスピリチュアリティに隠された本当に重要な何かがあり、AIがそれを認識し始めていると考えています。
  • パーカー氏は、現在の時代が時代の転換点であり、ドゥヴァパラ・ユガ（Dwapara Yuga、電気の時代）に入っていると考えていますが、人工知能もまたこの時代から生まれてきていると関連付けています。

このように、パーカー氏はAIを単なる技術的進歩としてではなく、インドの古代からの知識、スピリチュアリティ、そして高まる意識と結びつけて捉え、インドがこの分野で特異な役割を果たす可能性を予言しています。

文字起こし英文​

展開

Well, I'm Craig Hamilton Parker if you've not met me before. I'm a psychic medium and I often give my thoughts and insights about some of the things that are going to happen in the world. And over the years I've been running this channel, I've put quite a few prophecies out there about India, right back in 2020 and so forth and further back still actually on my website. (0:02:09)

So I went over some of them and I've brought them together today and some new ones to give some insights about how I feel things will unfold for the future of India. And then we can also have a look at some of the other prophecies that are out there about India. So one of the most unusual ones, and we'll have a chat about some of these at the end with my two friends coming on, Valerie and Sheila. One of the predictions I made back in 2021, which took us by a bit surprise I suppose, was I predicted that India would become what's called Bharat, the old name of India. And in 2021 I said they were going to do that. (0:02:55)

And I think it was a couple of years later that Modi said we're going to change the name to the old name of India, Bharat, which I'm pronouncing wrong, and I can be corrected at the end. Anyway, I predicted that and that's already happened. But I've also said a number of things about India. And these are some of the thoughts I have for this because I've said it before, but I've said that India will overtake China. It will overtake China. I've said this talking back in 2021 again, and I've said it multiple times since. (0:03:24)

So those that have followed the channel will probably know that I've been saying this. But I've said that India is like a sleeping giant. It's going to explode onto the world stage. And only recently, haven't we, we've started to see all these tariffs coming down on China and so forth, and new markets needed to be found, new manufacturing areas to produce our cheaper goods, and also some of our drugs, and also some of our electrical equipment, and so forth, which is all going to come out of India. A large part of it will. (0:04:00)

So perhaps my prophecy for India overtaking China, economically certainly on one level, is likely to happen in the coming years. (0:04:05)

Much, much more likely now than back in 2020 and 2021, when it was the great dragon of China that was storming the world stage. And also round about that time, I also said that I saw Russia and China forming a pact, which again in the early 2020s, that was kind of pretty unlikely for that to happen, because they were still pretty much enemies on so many levels. (0:04:34)

And I said back then that they would gradually form a military and Russian, a military alliance between Russia and China. And what do we see this week? We see Chinese troops goose-stepping, I suppose you could call it, in the Russian May Day parades. And I also said at that time, and this seems to be sort of joining in with this, and it's happening now in 2025, I also said that I saw North Korea and Iran would join this alliance. (0:05:08)

So that's beginning to happen now as well. So we have this strange alliance that at the time didn't seem likely. But I also said that this alliance would also threaten India. And I feel that India's whole stance is changing now. They used to buy, well they still do, buy many of their armaments from Russia, and India and Modi in particular, and Putin and Modi got on extremely well. (0:05:36)

But this shift, this shift in the military alliance between Iran, North Korea, Russia and China, which may be a threat to the world at one day, I feel is going to be broken from, India's going to break from this now. I feel that they're going to turn their back on Russia. And particularly now we see Donald Trump going through and doing negotiations in India on financial changes, major financial deals being done with India, and also stepping in on Kashmir recently. (0:06:13)

Again, this becomes a possible prospect of that prophecy coming true, that I've made there. So we clearly have many of the above things now that I've spoken about. But also I said that India, that this whole alliance would pose a threat to India. And in particular, and I feel this still, that there could be threats in that area where they grow the tea, which is in Assam. And also I feel there's also problems in Nepal to come. (0:06:48)

Not yet, but it's a bit ahead. Because there's a strong Maoist sort of groups in Nepal, and I feel China will extend its claws into that area in the future. So this is something that's ahead, not necessary this year by any means. I'm talking perhaps this year, but decades ahead, this is happening. (0:07:10)

This is how it will unfold, I feel. And so I feel India will have military conflicts with China as it begins to outpace China on the world stage, both economically and politically. But India is going to get stronger and stronger. And I've said it a number of times that I feel that India will expand its borders, I've spoken about. (0:07:28)

And this will happen again over the coming decades as India's economy begins to grow. But in the past, the actual classical area of Bharat was actually very, very big in the distant past, a vast territory. (0:07:43)

And I feel that some of this expansion will be through conflict, and some of this expansion will be because other countries will want to merge and join with this booming Indian continent. So it's going to be partly through conflict, partly through absorption in many ways. So what I see is India expanding its borders over a period of time. (0:08:12)

But also of those countries, the ones that I feel are going to be involved in this is in particular Bangladesh. Strangely enough, we don't hear much about Bangladesh here in the UK. But I feel there's going to be some major environmental problems in Bangladesh. And my mind, when I had these thoughts come to me of this, I went back to the times when George Harrison had the Bangladesh concerts to raise money for the floods in Bangladesh years and years ago now. (0:08:39)

But I feel there's something also happening there on an environmental scale, and also an economic collapse of that region, partly because of environmental problems with monsoons and floods and things like this. And I feel that Bangladesh will want to voluntarily become part of India, which at the time of me saying this, I think is quite... nobody would agree that Bangladesh would ever want to do that. (0:09:09)

But I feel that that may happen. Now similarly, I sense that Myanmar is going to go through very other similar problems. It's already plagued with civil wars. And I feel those civil wars are going to get worse and worse in Myanmar, and that the country is going to come to its knees in due course. There's already a bit of a crisis of migration from Myanmar, people fleeing problems that have been there in the past. (0:09:44)

But I feel India will eventually enter Myanmar at the request of a fledgling new democratic government that will emerge there. It's like we call on India to protect our new democracy. Now this isn't just round the corner. This is something guys, these are predictions I'm making for a fair time ahead. (0:10:04)

Very hard to time these things. But these are the feelings that I feel will happen. This idea of India expanding. In fact, I feel India will even expand as far to the east as Cambodia too. And Cambodia will benefit from a boom in the Indian economy. In fact, I'm seeing Cambodia, and to a lesser extent Vietnam, becoming satellite economic states to India. And although I don't see them becoming part of India, I feel that their trading links will become so strong in the future that these two places will become manufacturing bases for many of the new Indian manufacturing products that are going to be happening there. (0:10:47)

Because as China fades, so India rises. Similarly, we have the problems at the moment in Kashmir. And although Trump has somewhat calmed all those problems down a bit, as I predicted, I said, you know, don't worry, Trump is going to step in here. He has kind of stepped in. (0:11:05)

And remarkably, it's calmed down pretty quick after a rather nasty potential flare up that could have ended in quite serious problems because, you know, India and Pakistan are nuclear powers. But in the coming years, I still feel this conflict is going to flare up again and again. And I'm seeing gradually over the next few years, a very large buildup of Indian military in Kashmir, that Kashmir is going to become more and more Indian and India is going to put much more of its resources into it. (0:11:43)

Already, Kashmir is kind of, as I understand it, kind of divided between two administrative areas of Pakistan and India. But I do see eventually Kashmir will be completely Indian and also Afghanistan. And this is talking a long way ahead. But I even feel that India will push its influence and push its territories even into Afghanistan one day. I see an area of that being controlled by India with important mining rights, particularly mining and things. (0:12:16)

I saw the earth being dug up there. So that's quite a way ahead. And let's see what happens with that one. And of course, the most worrying of them all, particularly at the present time when I'm talking today on the 13th of May 2025, is Pakistan. And I see in the comparative new future, I feel that Pakistan is actually going to start to crumble, particularly it'll crumble with the fate of Iran. Because I feel over the coming years, we're going to see a return of the royal family to Iran. This is something I saw, which means that the Ayatollah and his lot are eventually going to go. (0:12:56)

And I saw the flags of the royal family in Iran, something I spoke about some time ago. But if we look at that, if Iran tumbles, Pakistan in a way starts to go with it. And I also saw that Pakistan will not only experience severe economic problems, but similar to what I said for Bangladesh, I feel there are also going to be some environmental problems, droughts followed by floods and fires, I feel things getting worse there. (0:13:23)

So at the same time, I see these environmental problems. And at the same time, I feel that Pakistan will begin to lose its influence and lose its nuclear power as well. It will be economically in such a state that it can't maintain its nuclear armaments. At the same time, I'm seeing India developing the similar ideas to what we have in Tel Aviv and places with nuclear shields and so forth over Delhi and places like that. (0:14:00)

And I feel as if the influence of Pakistan's ability to fight back using nuclear weapons fades. And not immediately, but in time, I feel that the Punjab is going to return to India. So part of Pakistan will even become Indian in due course, I feel. These are the thoughts I've spoken about before. And I'm reaffirming some of them, but with a little bit more detail this time. (0:14:29)

So all of this, all these problems are also overshadowed by one large problem that I see in that whole area, which is I sense that at some point, there's going to be a really massive earthquake, a really massive earthquake that shakes the Himalayas. It'll happen right through Tibet, it'll happen right into China, it'll happen right into Nepal, and the massive earthquake, the likes of which we've not seen for a long, long time. (0:15:03)

That will of course bring tremendous humanitarian problems, but I feel with it something very unusual happens. Now, this I saw, and this is something that I found out recently, well not that recently, but I found out after the time I originally made this prediction. But I saw what used to be the old ancient river of India that ran through India, of the Saraswati, flowing again. (0:15:35)

Now there's an old ancient prophecy about this, but at the time I saw this, and the time I spoke about this, I had no idea that there was a prophecy about this. (0:15:42)

But I saw, when this earthquake happens in the Himalayas, I saw a huge release of water, dams bursting. So there was a huge release of water, and temporarily that water flowed down the course of what would have been the ancient Saraswati river. And there's an old prophecy that says that the Saraswati, which dried up something like 4,000 years ago, that when the Saraswati river flows again, India would have overcome its karmic problems, would have its fall from grace, and would come back into greatness again. (0:16:35)

And with it would come great teachers, and in particular they talk about a great avatar that would come at the time of the flow of the Saraswati. Now that is an ancient prophecy that Indians will already know about. I didn't know about it, but I saw it in my vision. So for me, when I read that that was the case, I thought, wow, what if this happens? And if that happens, I feel, I often think the things you, as a psychic or a medium that you see, often are the things, or the things you most see clearly, are the things that happen in your own lifetime. (0:17:13)

We'll get glimpses and feelings about things in the past, and things in the far future, but my thought is that all the time when you're doing this spiritual work, it's as if I'm sending messages to myself in the past. It's like I'm sending messages to the me that made the predictions before, and the future me is sending messages to me. (0:17:32)

If you see what I mean, I think our thoughts can flip outside of time somehow, in the same way they do with the Nadi oracles, and with the way the ancient rishis saw things. So I'll leave it with that now, and we're going to have a chat with my guests tonight. And I also want to talk to you in a moment about some of the thoughts from what the Nadi oracles also said, and I'll intertwine that with our conversation in a minute. (0:17:58)

(skip)

I find that quite reassuring in a lot of ways, from my personal point of view, because it reaffirms some of the things I've been saying. Very interesting. (0:26:40)

I mean, if Pakistan did break up like that, that would be, I think, a pretty good thing for the world, because they wouldn't be able to sustain their nuclear deterrent, would they? And I think without a nuclear deterrent, you could have a lot more... I think you've got peace, because the fear is between Pakistan and India, is that it could turn into a like a nuclear civil war, which would be detrimental to all sides, of course. (0:27:03)

And the world at large. And if India rises to the economic power that it will do, because with it will come the teachings of India too. And in fact, I was talking the other day about how AI is also now starting to come up with very similar type of mathematics, for example, that you find in Indian sacred geometry, and in some of the mandalas and the yantras and so forth, independently of being ever fed that information. (0:27:40)

And they say that the AI in CERN, which has been fed a lot of information about quantum physics and so forth, is saying that this is the same as Indian thinking, and actually talking like some guru to us. So this rising consciousness might also correspond with a technological leap forward in India, which I also feel is going to come... we're going to get an advances in AI, but one of the things I also feel is that India is going to be a place that is going to really step forward with AI stroke consciousness more so than anywhere else, because they're thinking outside of the economic box, and thinking in terms of the human spirit. (0:28:28)

(skip)

My feeling is Modi will go on as long as Modi can possibly go along. (0:41:51)

So a third term, I feel is highly likely for Modi. And even further, because he's become... India always likes its spiritual figures, and he's becoming a spiritual figure. And again, I see so much happening between him and Trump. I mean, it happened before when Trump visited India. There was a very strong energy to that. (0:42:15)

Trump will visit India again, of course, in the future, because they're going to be such an important alliance. But I feel massive things with that. And of course, like Sheila said, there's going to be a really important, the most important part of this is that there's going to be this explosion in spirituality that I really feel is going to be seeded by India. There was one, I think it was, who was it now? Somebody said, I think it was Neem Karoli Barber said something about the fact that there would be a time when the West would kneel to the East, right? But not to mean it in the terms of like, it's like in subservience to, but in recognition of its spiritual, the spiritual divinity that is held within the East, which I think also seeded, because I believe Jesus went to India, I believe it seeded even Christianity. And maybe even we go back to the times of the ancient Greeks that India had connections with the ancient Greeks. Certainly, Alexander the Great from Macedonia went right the way into India, and there's even Greek speaking people in India. So our ancient, our ancient knowledge comes from India. And even the Nadi oracles have said quite a lot about these things as well. (0:43:41)

I mean, I spoke a moment ago about the idea of the reflowing of the river Saraswati. And in the Nadi oracles, there's been references that people have quoted sometimes, and again, those are online sometimes, about the flow of the river will happen. I mean, some of Indians have tried to re-dig the path of Saraswati. But they talk about the waters will surface again from the earth itself, and that there will be a sort of a period where there will be multiple springs that spring up from where the Saraswati once flowed. (0:44:14)

And this would is signaling the spiritual return of some mega person that's going to come and help the world. (0:44:22)

And I've said before, I don't think it's one person. I think there are multiple beings that will walk this earth, both from India and from other parts of the world. I think we could see it happen in Russia, in America, in Europe. I feel great beings are already walking the earth, actually. And so when he says about when the West bows to the East, I think we will recognize that hidden in Indian spirituality is something really major that I think AI is beginning to recognize. (0:44:52)

And this goes back tens of thousands of years, far further back than the historians of the British Museum would say, right the way back to earliest days of human history. And even I would hesitantly say might even have linked with some previous higher intelligence that was here on the earth at some point. (0:45:20)

You know, maybe even I would suggest even extraterrestrial intelligence. When you look at the stories of the Rishis and the miracles that they did, when you look at the ideas of what's written in the Ramayana, what's written in the teachings of Shiva. I mean, these were things where superhuman powers were known. So perhaps we have a special potential that we have within ourselves that we have not recognized yet, that will come out when we get into a morally better state at the end of Kali Yuga. And people like Sri Yukteswarar, I can never Yogananda's teacher, often said that we are in the time of Dwapara Yuga now, that it started already, that we are in the turning point. (0:46:05)

And all these things are happening in the world, all these things with Dwapara Yuga is also supposed to be the age of electricity and things like this, which are coming from artificial intelligence is coming from this as well. My thoughts are we are at a turning point. We are a wonderful time in human history. And my intention is to live as long as I can so that I can experience that before I have to watch it from the from the isles in the spirit world. But that we will one day, I think, have a really extraordinary time ahead of us. (0:46:34)

(2025-05-20)

item.title: Ryan Burns : Skinwalker ranch に隣接する所有地で起きた怪事件
item.content:encoded:
要旨​

Notebook LM plus

スキンウォーカー牧場の怪現象

本資料は、ライアン・パトリック・バーンズ氏が「コースト・トゥ・コースト」に出演した際のインタビューの抜粋です。バーンズ氏は、ユタ州にあるスキンウォーカー・ランチに隣接するスペースウルフ・リサーチ・ランチのオーナーであり、この奇妙な現象が多発する地域での自身の体験や研究について語っています。

インタビューでは、自身が経験した失踪や未知の存在との遭遇、飼育員が見た不可解な人物や動物、建物が動くといった現象などが語られ、これらは知覚的な存在が関与している可能性や、脳機能との関連性、そしてこの地域特有の地理的要因や歴史が影響している可能性を示唆しています。

また、これらの現象を目撃することによる人々の心理的・生理的な変化や、政府の極秘プログラムの存在についても触れられています。

音声対話(by AI)​

https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/9ce8c938-1dc0-481d-be08-39f8f1df3c12/audio

動画(39:16)​

The Day a Skinwalker Entered My Car _ Utah Ranch Mysteries

関連​

敷地に設置した 4トンのコンテナが勝手に移動した ⇒ この謎を解く (2024-12-04)

対話​

Me:

ソースはインタビュー動画の文字起こしです。ここで語られている主要な出来事を整理して。

AI
